create_MapCNN: create a MapCNN module to process acoustic or geometric map inputs with configurable output embedding size
build_MapCNN_geometric: build a MapCNN instance for geometric map processing with 200x200 input dimensions
build_MapCNN_acoustic: build a MapCNN instance for acoustic map processing with configurable kernel sizes and strides
test_MapCNN_forward: test the MapCNN forward pass by passing permuted observation tensors through the network
review_MapCNN_layer_init: review the MapCNN layer initialization and CNN architecture with three convolutional layers
